resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates an observation tower and cabin to 1934; the 1931 Klamath Forest Protective Association report describes a lookout tower and telephone line on the butte. The sources do not say whether these are the same structure, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two built dates: 1934 (register, with panorama photos May 1934) and 1931 (KFPA annual report quoted on Oregon Lookouts). Not reconciled; a human could check the KFPA annual report or a Forest Service history. Agency: register says U.S. Forest Service and Fremont NF; Oregon Lookouts files the 1931-1941 record under Klamath FPA. Removal: 'Removed' on Oregon Lookouts is undated. The 2005 photo caption on the register is not described. The NGS survey datasheet (designation QUARTZ, 1948 description of the summit) was seen embedded on Oregon Lookouts but not cited because it describes 1948 conditions; that embedded note also gives road directions from Bly, so the story's no-access claim is limited to the register. No current site description found.
